module: "Doors" marker for vehicles (for example the entrance of a garage or workshop) in play mode. Each door is a pair of scene objects (zone, icon): when the bounding box of the player's vehicle overlaps a zone, the icon rises slightly, an optional 3D screen is displayed for 5 s with a career computer sound, and the marker becomes interactive. The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: cluster: one per POI (id 'vehicleTrigger#<poi.id>'). Reads poi.markerInfo.vehicleTrigger.{doors, icon, iconLift, iconOffsetHeight, pos, radius, screens}; default icon poi_exclamationmark_round, default radius 6 m.
doors = list of {zoneObjectName, iconObjectName, maxVisibleDistance?}; default max visible distance 15 m. screens[idx] is the name of a scene object displayed next to door idx.
The overlap test only applies to the player's vehicle (data.veh); if a door overlaps the vehicle, all doors are marked as overlapped (anyOverlap).
The icon is only visible if the camera is close enough and without a static obstacle (castRayStatic); outside the big map.
Without prior setup (doors nil), several methods iterate over {} for safety; hide() however assumes area.iconInfo exists when the icon renderer is available.

create.desc: Builds a doors marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each vehicleTrigger POI into a distinct cluster and adds it to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

setup.desc: For each door, finds the zone object and the icon object in the scene, computes the zone's box, hides the associated screen and creates the icon (id <cluster.id>-vtIcon-<idx>).

update.desc: Every frame: tests the OBB/OBB overlap with the vehicle, handles the timer and the display of screens, animates the icons' height and opacity, draws a line, updates isInAreaChanged and anyOverlap.

data.desc: Frame data: veh, bbCenter, bbHalfAxis0..2, camPos, bigMapActive, dt.

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create any).

hide.desc: Becomes invisible, makes the icons transparent and hides the screens.

clearObjects.desc: Removes the icons, hides the screens and clears the door list.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and a door overlaps the vehicle, adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the interactive elements.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a circle on the minimap at the position of each door icon.
